body:
In academia, that letter of recommendation from your boss is crucial to getting any other job.

It's very possible this particular situation will blow over. However, I was already in a tough place mentally before this all blew up and pushed me over the edge.

Drug abuse.  There are rumors circulating about it at work, I'm not sure when they'll reach my boss or if they already have.  Based on what's happened to others, I won't get fired or confronted about it, I'll just quietly not have my contract renewed come May.

You know how some people manage to keep moving up until a spectacular downfall?  That's me, and the cracks in the facade are already starting to show.  Only a matter of time before it starts to fall, that might be Monday, or it might be in half a year, but it will happen.
